verdict.rationale: Bulk operations are a fair question for a compliance-automation SaaS like Sprinto, so the axis applies, but no evidence documents selecting and acting on many items at once (e.g., bulk assign, bulk update, bulk import) in the UI or API. The GraphQL Developer API with mutations and the automated workflows are developer building blocks or adjacent features, not a documented bulk-operation capability, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
